beats.say: Manchester United faced Bayern Munich on Wednesday 26 May 1999.
The historic match took place at Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain.
Mario Basler scored an early goal to put Bayern Munich ahead.
Teddy Sheringham scored an injury time equaliser for Manchester United.
Ole Gunnar Solskjær then scored another injury time goal to stun the stadium.
Manchester United won the match 2 to 1 and claimed their first European Cup title since 1968.

facts: The 1999 UEFA Champions league final was played on 26 May 1999 between Manchester United and Bayern Munich at Camp Nou in Barcelona.

Mario Basler scored an early goal for Bayern, but Teddy Sheringham and Ole Gunnar Solskjær scored in injury time for Manchester United to win 2 to 1 and claim their first European Cup title since 1968.
